output_schema.description: JSON object with a 'configurations' array, sorted by config_name (q1..q5), each element containing the fields below.

configuration_fields.config_name: string key matching query_configurations (q1 through q5)
configuration_fields.jacobian_linear: 3x7 nested array of floats, row-major order
configuration_fields.jacobian_angular: 3x7 nested array of floats, row-major order
configuration_fields.mass_matrix: 7x7 nested array of floats, symmetric positive definite, row-major order
configuration_fields.operational_inertia: 6x6 nested array of floats, row-major order
configuration_fields.condition_number: positive float: sigma_max / sigma_min of the full 6x7 Jacobian
